ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Mining Outpost Patch
ModMetaData.author: Kuhlyus
ModMetaData.description:
A Patch for the Mining Outpost from the Vanilla Outposts Expanded Mod to add Ores, Minerals and other mineable Stuff from other Mods. I try to add more "Ore Mods" in the future... if you got a sugestion, please tell me.
For now there are this Mods compatible with it:
MorrowRim - Glass and Ebony - Glass - Ebony
MorrowRim - Adamantium - Adamantium - Blessed Adamantium? (No... it needs to be blessed by Almalexia and i own her money... sooo... bad luck i guess. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯)
Medieval Overhaul - Coal - Citrine - Amber - Onyx - Emerald - Sapphire - Ruby - Iron Ore (for Steel) - Silver Ore (for Silver) - Gold Ore (for Gold) - removes Industrial Components (becurse Medieval and such)
Obsidia Expansion - Obsidian - Mythril - Platinum - Empyrium and Orichalcum? (No... Both needs to be synthesized and the Miners dont know how.)
Jewelry - Diamond - Ruby - Sapphire
[Ry]Rimcraft Metals - Thorium ore - Dark Iron ore - Mithril Ore - Adamantite Ore - True Silver Ore
Gemstones - Amethyst - Chalcedony - Citrine - Garnet - Lapis - Quartz - Serpentine - Turquoise - Emerald, Diamond, Ruby and Sapphire? (No... there have to be a surface vein available to be able to mine them at the outpost and this 4 can only be deepmined... sorry)
Vanilla Psycasts Expanded - Eltex
Kraltech Industries - Super Steel
Glitter Tech - Titanium
HRG164hjo's Starbound Mod - Bone - Coal - Glass - Erchius - Core Fragment - Diamond - Copper Ore - Iron Ore - Tungsten Ore - Titanium Ore - Durasteel Ore - Aegisalt Ore - Ferozium Ore - Violium Ore - Solarium Ore
RimFantasy - House Doyle - Amethyst
you dont have to add all of them in your Modlist. Just use the ones you like. It works with and without them.
Other Patches for the Mining Outpost i know:
Expanded Materials Metals Patch for Outposts Mines - Its made by Daria40K and she mostly did the same as i did... there should be no Problem when you load her Patch before mine. Same thing with the lite version.
RimFantasy Gemstones Patch for Outposts Mines - Also made by Daria40K with a lil twist she made seperat Mining Outpost just for the Gems... should also work if you load it before my Patch.
Thanks to:
- ScooterBug for pointing out an incompatibility bug with the Jewelry and the Gemstones mods... that helps a lot to code a solution for it! Now they should work with and without each other ;)
In case of any questions, sugestions or bugs, use Steam Workshop comment section.
